title: ZL Power GSIII 09C1 local runtime and separate PV command captures
summary: Owner cloud protocol identity is 2497/09C1; twelve earlier FC4 cycles match the manufacturer's fixed shapes. Two subsequent local support snapshots show eybond_09c1 connected with 22 fresh readings and no raw timeouts. Separate PV1/PV2 command captures qualify voltage/current in the fixed PV reply shape; PV? covers one channel on this unit, not a combined total. Physical labels appear crossed relative to protocol command numbers, but captures are non-simultaneous and do not establish a global port mapping, universal command support, or measured total power. Retail identity remains owner-reported, not inferred from replies.
